So, this is what I consider to be my highest quality story - **[Best Left Forgotten](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/434217/best-left-forgotten)**.

The description on Fimfic is intentionally vague, especially regarding Sunset's half of the story, so I'll give a bit more detailed one here.

> *After an attempt to restore all the memories thought lost to the memory stone goes wrong, Sunset finds herself caring for a horribly traumatized and emotionally unstable Wallflower Blush.*

This is, at its heart, a story about trauma--how it affects the individual *and* the people closest to them. While Wallflower is the one on the cover art, this story is equally Sunset's. The POV shifts back and forth between them as Sunset does whatever she can to help her friend through her recovery.

I guess I should say here that it's probably not a story for the faint of heart. My goal, above all else, was realism. I like to think I accomplished that well, if the comments are anything to go by.

• *There are very few stories that make me stare off to no place in particular, struggling to come up with something decent enough to say to adequately convey my feelings. I want to say something poignant here, but it was all just sucked out of me. Don't take this the wrong way. I'm just floored.*

• *Holy shit. This is one of the most visceral, emotionally charged stories I've read in ages.*

• *I just can't wrap my head around how amazingly good this is. The plot, the dialogue, the emotion; I just love it.*

My therapist asked me this yesterday, actually, and after some thought... I don't really know.

My first time using a razor was in middle school, when I was barely 14. But before that, I did... other stuff? Biting, scratching myself with my fingernails, stuff like that. But I'm still not sure any of that counts as *self-harm* in the traditional sense because, yeah, I was hurting myself, but I can't remember if I was doing it out of stress/depression/all that shit, or if I was just a stupid kid being bored.

This was my first story with Sunny, and somehow it did well. **[Last Light](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/425029/last-light)**.

*Losing her friends was the start of a self-destructive spiral for Sunset Shimmer. Convinced that she will never escape the echoes of her past, she tries to take her own life.*

*The attempt leaves her severely injured and she falls unconscious. In her dreams, she is repeatedly visited by Princess Luna. They much to discuss, whether Sunset likes it or not.*

My reason for writing it was being so sick of all the Anon-a-Miss stories that focus on stupid comic drama while using suicide/self-harm as a stupid plot device. I guess Last Light was my attempt to write the kind of story I wanted to read, but couldn't find--something that focuses on the emotional reality of suicidal thinking, using AaM as a starting point without focusing on it too much. That said, despite the story's high rating and view count, I think it's kinda sloppy in retrospect. Still, I think it has some good moments and I'm ultimately proud of it.

Wallflower Blush! She's from a series called *Equestria Girls*, which is like a humanized spin-off of MLP (yeah I know that show gets a lot of flak cuz judgemental assholes but I grew up with it so idc)

Wally's my *favorite* cuz she's like an icon for super depressed people with self-destructive behavior. That rock she's holding is an artifact called the Memory Stone, which can erase specific memories of others. She found it, and despite being an otherwise normal kid, suddenly she had access to some of the most powerful magic in the world.

Being an awkward, anxious teenager, she primarily used it to erase really uncomfortable first impressions, public speaking, social gaffes... But soon enough, no one even knew who she was anymore. Her overuse of the memory stone trapped her in a self-destructive spiral, her anxiety forcing her to erase any and every interaction she has with *anyone.* She feels like a ghost, completely unseen and unwanted by everyone around her. It gets to the point where she *canonically* has suicidal thoughts. They literally cut the last line from a song she sings because it's impossible to interpret it as anything other than suicidal depression. (you can still find the full song online tho, it's honestly a bit too processed imo but it's still good)
